scope: Execution definitions omitted from the original preregistration; no threshold, model, context, k, prompt-semantic, or classification rule is changed.

cpu_track_e.physical_boundary: Windows Energy Meter RAPL_Package0_PKG CPU package through direct PDH; no wall, system, isolated-core, or NPU claim
cpu_track_e.repeated_window_rationale: The qualified 1000-ms sampler can leave a single approximately two-second generation with too few interior samples. Freeze the minimum conservative three identical generations before formal data; each generation remains exactly 128 tokens and aggregate energy is normalized by 384 output tokens.
cpu_track_e.prompt_construction: Byte-identical Phase-1 token IDs and frozen hashes at each context
cpu_track_e.integration: QPC/perf_counter midpoint, linear boundary interpolation, trapezoidal integration
cpu_track_e.primary: CPU-package joules per generated output token
cpu_track_e.latency_use: Generation duration defines integration bounds only and is prohibited from replacing Track-L latency.

target_gpu.binding_result: PASS: explicit JSON devices=Vulkan0, 37/37 model layers and all 36 KV layers on Vulkan0; no AUTO/MULTI/HETERO and no CPU fallback

tb.definition: Target-only steady-state cost of one llama_decode token after a matching synthetic prefix depth, using the repository cross-platform llama-bench PP1 construction.
tb.prompt_candidate_construction: llama-bench deterministic internal synthetic token stream; depth pre-populates KV and PP1 advances one target token
tb.timing_boundary: llama-bench samples_ns around synchronized llama_decode; load, allocation, prefix construction and warm-up excluded

v2.definition: V_2 = median synchronized PP2 verification time / median synchronized PP1 decode time at the same prefix depth.
v2.exact_path: Serialized ubatch=1 path ported from the existing Windows/B570 verification controls; batched ubatch=2 is forbidden.
v2.prompt_candidate_construction: Repository cross-platform llama-bench PP1/PP2 synthetic candidates on the target model; k=2
v2.synchronization: llama-bench synchronized llama_decode samples; PP1 and PP2 emitted by the same invocation per context
v2.timing_boundary: samples_ns only; model load, allocation, KV-prefix preparation and warm-up excluded
v2.ordering: contexts 512,2048,8192; within each context llama-bench PP1 then PP2 with 20 samples each

exactness_gate.speculative: llama.cpp draft-simple with target and canonical Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 draft both explicitly on Vulkan0, ubatch=1
exactness_gate.pass_rule: all 18 paired generated token-ID sequences exactly equal

phase2_unchanged.T_d_2_construction: two times each formal Phase-1 per-token TPOT sample at matching context
